provenance.source: Authored synthetic bibliographic-shaped records, not real papers, not provider data. Eval-only, never product fallback.
provenance.capture: No actual provider, OpenClaw transport, or historical user capture.
provenance.baseline: Synthetic frozen rank ordering; NOT a captured historical current-v2 baseline.
provenance.judge: Author-assigned arithmetic labels; no independent blind judges or private user outcomes.
provenance.protocol: Synthetic correctness only. Thirty-six artificial clusters are not independent real users or a power claim. Fixed labels, split and zero-baseline inconclusive handling.
provenance.temporal: Invented timestamps test leakage checks, not authenticated event-time evidence.
provenance.exposure_denominators: Unavailable: no actual exposures, eligible active users, unavailable users, visible user-days, or attributable saves/reviews.
